reason: In src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:337-347 the deadline check at lines 338-341 does `break` before the `process.terminate()` at lines 346-347, so once the deadline has passed (for example after `self.next_step.join(timeout)` at line 334 uses up the timeout) the current and all remaining flusher processes are never terminated. The pre-patch code always called `self.process.terminate()` after the wait loop.
